word_count_method: English alphabetic tokens with internal hyphens/apostrophes; TeX prose estimate removes comments, dollar/display math and labels/citations/record identifiers before stripping commands. Bibliography included; formula words are not linguistic words.
pdf_token_method: Poppler pdftotext then the same alphabetic-token regex; includes headings, running headers, bibliography and single-letter math tokens.
scan_scope: Complete TeX except the single AI-use paragraph; current version/date and bibliographic version designations are allowed, not workflow history.

exceptions.reason: Explicitly requested public AI-tool disclosure, one occurrence each.
